# SCI-POINT Terminal-FRUIT Ancestry Envelope

Identity: `SCI-FRUIT_TERMINAL_TO_SCI-POINT v0.1/r0.3`

FRUIT is ancestry on one exact terminal MAP, JINC, FLT-FIXED, or
FLT-MATCHED product, never a fifth parent class. The finite envelope binds:

- terminal parent type and exact terminal immutable product;
- FRUIT method/version, terminal iteration, generation, recurrence state, and
  restart lineage;
- terminal response, support/validity, uncertainty/covariance, calibration,
  null/additive-reference, lifecycle, and provenance;
- exact route-specific compatibility and expected-centroid-bias state; and
- an assertion that the admitted product is terminal rather than intermediate.

Intermediate FRUIT iterations and coadds are excluded. Terminal ancestry does
not prove model adequacy or numerical fit availability and cannot change the
underlying route identity.
